description: A plain, semantic data table styled with the grid.* roles DBee's DataGrid uses: sticky header, density-aware rows, sortable headers, NULL marker, and a virtualized body for large row counts.

manifest.name: table
manifest.title: Table
manifest.description: A plain, semantic data table styled with the grid.* roles DBee's DataGrid uses: sticky header, density-aware rows, sortable headers, NULL marker, and a virtualized body for large row counts.
manifest.usage: Use Table for records with the same columns: a table's columns, indexes, grants, the audit log, a small query result. Compose Table (aria-label, or TableCaption with aria-labelledby) > TableHeader > TableRow > TableHead, then TableBody > TableRow > TableCell, and an optional TableFooter. It is presentational: the app sorts (TableHead sort + onSort), selects (TableRow selected) and pages. Cells keep one line and truncate (wrap lets one wrap); align="end" for numbers; TableNull for SQL NULL. For more than about 1,000 rows, give the Table a height and use TableVirtualBody with count and renderRow; browsers cap an element's height near 33.5 million px, so it serves up to about 900,000 rows at the comfortable row height (1.5 million compact). Put the Table in a parent that lets it shrink (min-w-0) so wide tables scroll inside it. For streamed Arrow results with cell selection and column resizing use the DataGrid package (TSK-39); for term/value pairs use DescriptionList.

props.name: variant
props.description: striped: alternate rows in grid.row-bg-alt; bordered: rules between columns.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the table; the scroll container becomes a focusable region.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Names the table by another element (its TableCaption's id).

props.name: children
props.description: TableCaption, TableHeader, TableBody or TableVirtualBody, TableFooter.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the scroll container; give it a height to scroll.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The scroll container, a focusable region when labelled; data-slot="table", data-variant.

slots.name: element
slots.description: The <table>; data-slot="table-element"; aria-rowcount with a virtual body.

slots.name: virtual-body
slots.description: Renders the rows in view between two aria-hidden spacer rows; data-slot="table-virtual-body", data-first, data-last.

slots.name: head
slots.description: scope="col", sticky, grid.header-bg; data-slot="table-head", data-align, aria-sort.

slots.name: sort
slots.description: The sort button inside a sortable head; data-slot="table-sort".

slots.name: cell
slots.description: grid.row-height, grid.cell-padding-x, truncates; data-slot="table-cell", data-align, data-wrap.

parts.name: TableHeader
parts.description: The <thead>; its heads stick while the body scrolls.

parts.name: TableBody
parts.description: The <tbody> for rows you render (up to about 1,000).

parts.name: TableVirtualBody
parts.description: A <tbody> that renders only the rows in view: count, renderRow, overscan, headerRows.

parts.name: TableHead
parts.description: A column header: align, sort, onSort.

parts.name: TableCaption
parts.description: What the table lists; names it.

parts.name: TableNull
parts.description: A SQL NULL, distinct from an empty string.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a row: grid.row-hover; over a sort button: color.fg.default.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the region or a sort button: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: align-end
states.description: End-aligned heads and cells; cells use tabular figures.

states.name: wrap
states.description: A cell that wraps instead of truncating.

accessibility: A real <table> with <thead>, <th scope="col"> and <td>, so screen readers announce headers with each cell; name it with aria-label or a TableCaption referenced by aria-labelledby.
A labelled table's scroll container is a focusable region, so keyboard users can scroll a tall or wide table with the arrow keys.
A sortable column's label is a button; the current order is aria-sort on the <th> and an icon (aria-hidden).
TableVirtualBody keeps the semantic table: the <table> has aria-rowcount (all rows plus the header) and each rendered row its aria-rowindex; the spacer rows are aria-hidden.
Selected rows set aria-selected; NULL is the word NULL, not a colour; truncated cells should carry the full value in title.
Not an interactive grid: no cell focus or arrow-key movement between cells. For that, use the DataGrid (ARIA grid pattern).
